name: Packing Lists
description: Shared packing checklists for trips — build the list together, assign items to people, start from a template, and watch the bags fill up.

source.query: SELECT l.id AS id, l.title AS title, l.trip_date AS when_at, CASE WHEN COUNT(i.id) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS done FROM app_packing_lists__lists l LEFT JOIN app_packing_lists__items i ON i.list_id = l.id AND i.packed = 0 WHERE l.archived = 0 AND l.trip_date = :today GROUP BY l.id ORDER BY l.created_at LIMIT 20
SELECT title AS title, trip_date AS leaves_on FROM app_packing_lists__lists WHERE archived = 0 AND trip_date <> '' AND trip_date >= :today ORDER BY trip_date LIMIT 3
